*[[Estonian parliamentary election, 2015]]
**The ruling [[Estonian Reform Party|Reform Party]] wins the elections, but loses the majority that it has had with its current coalition partner, the [[Social Democratic Party (Estonia)|Social Democratic Party]]; for the first time in many years, two new parties cross the election threshold, the right-of-centre [[Free Party (Estonia)|Free Party]] and the eurosceptic [[Conservative People's Party of Estonia]].
